resources.string: Phase 0 throwaway probe. This app exists only to prove the adb-reverse packet tunnel (implementation-plan §3.1). Bootstrap secret over adb stdin + mutual HMAC (§3.4); no rate limiting. Do not use on an unmanaged LAN.
Missing extras. Start with:\nam start -n dev.routedroid.phase0/.BootstrapActivity --es session <id> --ei device_port <port>
No bootstrap record from the adb shell (missing, expired, or for another session). Nothing started.
